ideas.idea: Make /shop list real products with their own pages and links
ideas.why: The shop page only has one sentence naming three categories, so individual product pages would give crawlers and readers real content.

ideas.idea: Move Product data to individual product pages with offers, and drop it from the list page
ideas.why: The Product markup sits on a category-style page and has only a name, so this fits the repo.

ideas.idea: Add ordinary visible delivery terms or a delivery page linked from the nav
ideas.why: Delivery information exists only in a data-nosnippet div, so no readable page answers delivery questions, and the report leaves the nosnippet choice alone.

ideas.idea: Support the 'shipped next day' claim with cutoff, countries and carrier details
ideas.why: The home h1 makes the claim and nothing in the files backs it up.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data with business name and contact details
ideas.why: No entity markup exists, though the report admits the site shows no name or contact details to base it on.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag and a <main> element in app.html
ideas.why: app.html has no viewport meta and wraps the body in a plain div, so both are accurate and concrete.

ideas.idea: Link the home page onward to /shop and categories in the body
ideas.why: The home page has only an h1, and the nav is the only link path to the shop.

ideas.idea: Make the /shop title more descriptive and branded
ideas.why: 'Shop all parts' lacks the brand and category terms that the home title has.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap or generate it from routes
ideas.why: This is accurate, but a two-URL sitemap gains little from lastmod.

ideas.idea: Define the base URL in one place instead of hardcoding it
ideas.why: It is accurate, but it is a maintainability tip that would apply to nearly any site.
